goal: Persist every whisper that the live SummonScout whisper-confirmation engine classifies as unknown and automatically publish the bounded SavedVariables telemetry as a GPT-readable GitHub Issue without uploading unrelated account data.
shared_resources: WoW112 updater DPAPI report token and GitHub Issue API
notes: The reporter does not reimplement summon intent. It wraps the registered whisperconfirm module and records only messages that reach its existing unknown-probe path, plus unparsed replies while that probe is pending. Known/handled whispers, manual-conversation locks and whispers that become a successful invite before the probe are not dumped. A bounded 250-entry ring is persisted. The updater polls flushed SummonScout SavedVariables, uploads only unknownWhisperReport, deduplicates by SHA256 and chunks oversized reports into GitHub Issue comments. WoW flushes SavedVariables on /reload, logout or client exit. The updater delivery profile is mandatory because tools/updater is changed; auto-integration remains gated by exact feature-SHA preflight and updater profile PASS.
